title.zh: 从微观规则到涌现
title.en: From microscopic rules to emergence

title.zh: 冷却液体直到结晶，再把它熔化
title.en: Cool a liquid until it crystallises, then melt it

hint.zh: 粒子之间只有一条两体势；看有序是怎么自己长出来、又怎么消失的
hint.en: Only a pair potential acts between the particles; watch order appear by itself, then vanish

title.zh: 把时间倒过来：晶体熔化，再自己拼回去
title.en: Run time backwards: a crystal melts, then reassembles itself

hint.zh: 把所有速度反号，熔化的晶体一步不差地退回原样
hint.en: Flip every velocity and the melted crystal retraces its path exactly

title.zh: 粒子在管道里流成抛物线
title.en: Particles in a pipe settle into a parabola

hint.zh: 没有人写过流体方程；流速剖面由粒子碰撞自己长成抛物线
hint.en: Nobody wrote a fluid equation; collisions alone shape the velocity profile into a parabola

title.zh: 三维里的管道流：同一条抛物线
title.en: Channel flow in 3D: the same parabola

hint.zh: 五万多个粒子夹在两面热壁之间，加一个小力，流速剖面自己长成抛物线
hint.en: 55,000 particles between two thermal walls; add a small force and the velocity profile grows into a parabola

title.zh: 流过一个圆盘：背后出现回流
title.en: Flow past a disc: backflow appears behind it

hint.zh: 十一万个粒子流过圆盘，看背风面的流体怎么倒着走
hint.en: 110,000 particles flow past a disc; watch the fluid behind it run backwards

title.zh: 圆盘后面的尾迹有没有周期
title.en: Does the wake behind the disc have a period

hint.zh: 在尾迹里放一个探测区，量它左右摆动的频率（要跑几分钟）
hint.en: A probe in the wake measures how often it swings from side to side (takes a few minutes)

title.zh: 从下面加热：对流卷
title.en: Heat from below: convection rolls

hint.zh: 下壁热、上壁冷，把重力加大，气体自己分成一对对的卷
hint.en: Hot wall below, cold above: turn gravity up and the gas sorts itself into pairs of rolls

title.zh: 对流从多强的重力开始
title.en: How strong must gravity be for convection to start

hint.zh: 重力分六档往上加，看对流强度在哪一档离开热噪声
hint.en: Gravity rises in six steps; see at which one the convection measure leaves the thermal noise

title.zh: 敲一下，量声速
title.en: Tap it and measure the speed of sound

hint.zh: 推一下气体，看驻波来回摆，再和由粒子数据算出的声速比
hint.en: Push the gas, watch the standing wave swing, and compare with the sound speed computed from the particles

title.zh: 让机器从粒子数据里发现扩散方程
title.en: Let the machine find the diffusion equation in particle data

hint.zh: 两种粒子慢慢混合；程序从浓度的记录里拟合出它服从的方程
hint.en: Two species slowly mix; the program fits the equation they obey from the recorded concentration

title.zh: 同一条势，换一个维度
title.en: The same potential in another dimension

hint.zh: 同一条两体势，从二维换到三维，压强和结构跟着变
hint.en: The same pair potential, moved from 2D to 3D: pressure and structure change with it

title.zh: 三维过冷液体：等一个晶核
title.en: A supercooled 3D liquid: waiting for one nucleus

hint.zh: 把三维液体冷到凝固点以下，等晶体从某一处长出来
hint.en: Cool a 3D liquid below freezing and wait for the crystal to start somewhere

title.zh: 三维的一团粒子
title.en: A cloud of particles in 3D

hint.zh: 不带引导的三维分子动力学；可以暂停和重置
hint.en: Unguided 3D molecular dynamics; pause and reset as you like

title.zh: 两种互相不喜欢的粒子自己分开
title.en: Two species that dislike each other separate by themselves

hint.zh: 同种粒子相吸、异种粒子吸得弱，看混在一起的两种颜色怎么分成块
hint.en: Like attracts like more than unlike; watch two mixed colours sort into patches

title.zh: 一头亲水一头疏水的分子自己聚成小团
title.en: Molecules with a water-loving head and water-hating tails gather into small clusters

hint.zh: 高温时各走各的；降温后尾朝里、头朝外聚成十来个分子的小团
hint.en: Hot, they wander alone; cooled, they gather into clusters of about ten with tails inside and heads outside

title.zh: 同一个模型，同一个温度，换一个维度
title.en: The same model at the same temperature in another dimension

hint.zh: 同一个温度，二维的自旋是乱的，三维的排整齐了
hint.en: At one temperature the 2D spins are disordered while the 3D ones line up

title.zh: 把 Ising 晶格淬火穿过临界温度
title.en: Quench an Ising lattice through the critical temperature

hint.zh: 突然降温，看畴怎么长大
hint.en: Cool it suddenly and watch the domains grow

title.zh: 停在临界点上的 Ising 晶格
title.en: An Ising lattice held at its critical point

hint.zh: 临界温度下各种大小的团块同时存在；旁边是逐级粗粒化后的样子
hint.en: At the critical temperature clusters of every size coexist; beside it, the lattice coarse-grained level by level

title.zh: 三维 Ising 模型的一个切片
title.en: A slice through the 3D Ising model

hint.zh: 三维晶格停在它自己的临界温度附近，显示其中一层
hint.en: A 3D lattice near its own critical temperature, showing one layer of it

title.zh: 多一种状态，相变就换一种：连续的变成不连续的
title.en: More states, a different transition: continuous turns discontinuous

hint.zh: 三种状态时两种出发点到同一个能量；八种状态时停在两个能量上，差的就是潜热
hint.en: With three states both starts reach one energy; with eight they settle at two, a latent heat apart

title.zh: 停在相变点上的三态 Potts 模型
title.en: A three-state Potts model held at its transition

hint.zh: 三种颜色的团块，各种大小都有；旁边是逐级粗粒化后的样子
hint.en: Patches of three colours at every size; beside it, the lattice coarse-grained level by level

title.zh: 一团静止的天体坍缩，然后自己找到平衡
title.en: A cloud of bodies at rest collapses, then finds its own balance

hint.zh: 只有引力；看它怎么自己稳下来
hint.en: Gravity only; watch it settle by itself

title.zh: 四千个天体，只有引力
title.en: Four thousand bodies under gravity alone

hint.zh: 不带引导的引力 N 体；可以暂停和重置
hint.en: Unguided gravitational N-body; pause and reset as you like

title.zh: 几乎均匀的物质自己长出丝和团块
title.en: Nearly uniform matter grows filaments and clumps by itself

hint.zh: 二十六万个粒子只有引力，从 3% 的涨落出发；把显示切到“中间的薄片”
hint.en: 260,000 particles under gravity alone, starting from 3% fluctuations; switch the display to the middle slab

title.zh: 一个密度波自己塌成一张薄片
title.en: A density wave collapses into a sheet by itself

hint.zh: 幅度按 e^{γt} 增长，塌缩的时刻可以事先算出来
hint.en: The amplitude grows as e^{γt}, and the moment of collapse can be computed in advance

summary.zh: 从微观规则到涌现：只模拟最底层（粒子的对势、格点自旋、引力），温度、压强、粘度、相变、晶体序这些更高层的量都从微观数据算出，并与已知理论对照。五种底座：分子动力学（md）、Ising 自旋（ising）、Potts 模型（potts）、引力 N 体（gravity）、粒子网格法的引力成团（mesh）。这里给出的是数据：每个底座有哪些可改的假设（knobs）、能量出哪些量（quantities）、19 个引导实验（scenarios）、拿来对照的理论数值和出处（references）。先看 substrates，再按 substrate 字段查另外几份。模拟本身在浏览器里用 WebGPU 跑，这里暂时没有可以调用的计算；knobs 和 scenarios 里的 url 可以交给人在浏览器里打开。
summary.en: From microscopic rules to emergence: only the bottom level is simulated (a pair potential between particles, lattice spins, gravity), and higher-level quantities such as temperature, pressure, viscosity, phase transitions and crystalline order are computed from the microscopic data and compared with known theory. Five substrates: molecular dynamics (md), Ising spins (ising), the Potts model (potts), gravitational N-body (gravity) and particle-mesh gravitational clustering (mesh). What is offered here is data: the assumptions each substrate lets you change (knobs), the quantities it measures (quantities), 19 guided experiments (scenarios), and the theoretical values they are compared with, with sources (references). Start with substrates, then query the others by their `substrate` field. The simulations themselves run in a browser on WebGPU and there is no callable computation here yet; the `url` fields in knobs and scenarios can be given to a person to open.

title.zh: 底座
title.en: Substrates

description.zh: 五种被模拟的微观系统：名称、一句话说明、时间的单位（步数或扫描数）、打开它的地址。
description.en: The five microscopic systems that are simulated: name, a one-sentence description, the unit of time (steps or sweeps) and the URL that opens it.

provenance.zh: 由源码里的定义生成（bun run agent），有一条测试保证它与源码一致。英文是为这份数据写的，界面本身是中文的。
provenance.en: Generated from the definitions in the source (bun run agent); a test keeps it in step with the source. The English was written for this dataset; the UI itself is in Chinese.

title.zh: 旋钮：可以改的假设
title.en: Knobs: the assumptions you can change

description.zh: 每个底座的每个旋钮：取值范围、默认值、离散选项、它属于哪一类假设（tag：class 改变普适类，value 只改变数值，state 状态变量，numerical 数值方法，toy 玩具规则）、改动后要重建什么（rebuild）、偏离默认值会打破哪条守恒律（breaks）。id 是 底座.旋钮。地址栏里写 ?substrate=<底座>&<旋钮>=<值> 就能直达，url 字段是一个例子。shown_by_default 为 false 的旋钮只在别的旋钮取某些值时才出现在界面上。note 和 breaks 只有中文。
description.en: Every knob of every substrate: range, default, discrete options, the kind of assumption it is (`tag`: class changes the universality class, value changes numbers only, state is a state variable, numerical is the numerical method, toy is a toy rule), what must be rebuilt when it changes (`rebuild`) and which conservation law breaks once it leaves its default (`breaks`). `id` is substrate.knob. Writing ?substrate=<substrate>&<knob>=<value> in the address bar opens that state directly; the `url` field is an example. A knob with `shown_by_default` false only appears in the UI for certain values of other knobs. `note` and `breaks` are in Chinese only.

provenance.zh: 由源码里的定义生成（bun run agent），有一条测试保证它与源码一致。范围和默认值就是界面用的那一份。英文名是为这份数据写的。
provenance.en: Generated from the definitions in the source (bun run agent); a test keeps it in step with the source. Ranges and defaults are the very ones the UI uses. The English names were written for this dataset.

title.zh: 派生量：从微观数据算出的量
title.en: Quantities: what is computed from the microscopic data

description.zh: 每个底座能算出的量和分析：属于阶梯的哪一层（level：micro、kinetic、thermo、hydro、structure、meta）、是标量、曲线、场还是对历史记录的分析（kind）、有没有理论对照（has_theory）、理论说明（theory_note，只有中文）、算作相符的容差（tolerance）。id 是 底座.量。shown_by_default 为 false 的量只在某些旋钮取值下才有。
description.en: The quantities and analyses each substrate can compute: its rung on the ladder (`level`: micro, kinetic, thermo, hydro, structure, meta), whether it is a scalar, a curve, a field or an analysis over a recorded history (`kind`), whether it has a theory to compare with (`has_theory`), a note on that theory (`theory_note`, Chinese only) and the tolerance for counting as agreement (`tolerance`). `id` is substrate.quantity. A quantity with `shown_by_default` false exists only for certain knob settings.

provenance.zh: 由源码里的定义生成（bun run agent），有一条测试保证它与源码一致。has_theory 只说明代码里有一条理论线，不说明实测与它相符；相符与否、差多少见 references 的 measured 字段和项目的 README。
provenance.en: Generated from the definitions in the source (bun run agent); a test keeps it in step with the source. `has_theory` only says the code carries a theory line, not that the measurement agrees with it; for agreement and its size see the `measured` field of references and the project README.

title.zh: 引导实验
title.en: Guided experiments

description.zh: 19 个一步步演示的实验：每一步设哪些旋钮（set）、跑多少步（run）、做什么动作（action）、预期看到什么以及按哪个量检验（expect）。url 在浏览器里直接打开并自动播放。步骤的文字只有中文，标题有英文（title_en）。步数是按 GPU 后端定的，有的实验在 CPU 上要跑很久。
description.en: 19 experiments played step by step: which knobs each step sets (`set`), how many steps it runs (`run`), what it does (`action`), and what should be seen and which quantity checks it (`expect`). The `url` opens one in a browser and plays it. The step texts are in Chinese only; the title also has English (`title_en`). Step counts were chosen for the GPU backend, so some experiments would take very long on a CPU.

provenance.zh: 由源码里的定义生成（bun run agent），有一条测试保证它与源码一致。expect 里的阈值是在这个项目自己的运行里定的，不是文献值。每个实验都在 GPU 上播放检验过，但不是每次改动后都重跑全部。
provenance.en: Generated from the definitions in the source (bun run agent); a test keeps it in step with the source. The thresholds under `expect` were set from this project's own runs and are not literature values. Every experiment was played and checked on a GPU, though not all are replayed after every change.

title.zh: 理论参照
title.en: Reference values

description.zh: 模拟结果拿来对照的数：临界温度、临界指数、潜热、增长率等。status 说明它是严格结果（exact）、拟合（fit）、数值结果（numerical）还是理想结构的参照值（reference）；formula 是公式和适用条件；source 是出处；measured 是这个项目自己量到的结果（有记录的才有）；有的条目带一张表（table）。单位：粒子体系用 Lennard-Jones 约化单位，自旋模型取 J = 1，引力取 G = 1。
description.en: The numbers simulation results are compared with: critical temperatures, critical exponents, latent heats, growth rates and so on. `status` says whether a value is exact, a fit, a numerical result or a reference value for an ideal structure; `formula` gives the formula and where it holds; `source` the origin; `measured` what this project itself measured (only where on record); some entries carry a `table`. Units: Lennard-Jones reduced units for particles, J = 1 for spin models, G = 1 for gravity.

datasets.licence: MIT (values computed by this repository's code from published formulas; cited works keep their own copyright)

provenance.zh: 数值由 src/theory 里的函数现算，四舍五入到十位有效数字。出处一栏：二维 LJ 状态方程（Homes 等 2025）对照过它公开的原始数据；Baxter 的潜热（q = 8 为 0.486358）与文献里的数值对过；Selke (2006) 和 Wu (1982) 是代码注释里当时记下的出处；其余的期刊卷页是凭记忆写的，没有逐条核对。三维 Ising 的三个数值和三态 Potts 的指数在 source 里写明了没有出处记录。measured 里的数来自这个项目自己的测试，只在一台机器上跑过。
provenance.en: Values are computed by the functions in src/theory and rounded to ten significant digits. On the sources: the 2D LJ equation of state (Homes et al. 2025) was compared with its published raw data; Baxter's latent heat (0.486358 for q = 8) was compared with numbers in the literature; Selke (2006) and Wu (1982) are the sources noted in the code comments when the values were added; the remaining journal references were written from memory and not checked one by one. The three 3D Ising values and the three-state Potts exponent say in `source` that no citation is on record. The numbers under `measured` come from this project's own tests, run on one machine only.
